entities.name: Great Northern War & the Great Wrath

entities.summary: Russia's occupation of Finland during the Great Northern War (1714–1721), known as the 'Great Wrath' (Isoviha) for its devastating impact — famine, forced labour, and deportations killing a third of Finland's population.
